verdict.rationale: Calendly's routing page documents routing forms that use answer-based logic to screen and qualify people before they book. It also documents building scheduling routes from form fields and matching known leads to their assigned account owners, and a routing_form_submission webhook confirms routing forms are a first-class feature. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of routing in practice, and in-depth docs on configuring destinations (routing to a team or round-robin pool rather than one person).

support.subject: As a sales lead, a routing form qualifies invitees and sends them to the right person or team based on their answers

citations.quote: Create a routing form that uses basic routing logic (fixed answer responses) to screen and qualify people before they book with you.
Import third party forms into Calendly and simply build scheduling routes from visible or hidden fields — as well as Salesforce ownership status.
Automatically look up and match known leads to assigned account owners from Salesforce and HubSpot.
Subscribing to the **`routing_form_submission.created`** event will fire anytime someone submits a routing form, whether they book or not.
